text:
Predicates:
Striker(x) ::: x is a striker.
SoccerPlayer(x) ::: x is a soccer player.
Left(x, y) ::: x left y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.

Premises:
Striker(x) → SoccerPlayer(x) ::: Strikers are soccer players.
Left(RobertLewandowski, BayernMunich) ::: Robert Lewandowski left Bayern Munich.
∀x ∀y (Left(x, y) → ¬PlaysFor(x, y)) ::: If a player left a team, they no longer play for that team.

Conclusion:
PlaysFor(RobertLewandowski, BayernMunich)
